text.A: **Ushbu siyosat qayerda boʻlishingizdan qatʼi nazar amal qiladi.** Biz Buyuk Britaniyaning maʼlumotlarni himoya qilish toʻgʻrisidagi qonunchiligiga amal qilamiz, siz yashaydigan mamlakatning maʼlumotlarni himoya qilish toʻgʻrisidagi qonunchiligi ham qoʻllaniladigan hollarda esa unga ham amal qilamiz.
text.B: **Allergiya va parhez haqidagi izohlar.** Biz ularni buyurtmangiz bilan birga fudtrakka uzatamiz va ulardan boshqa hech narsa uchun foydalanmaymiz. Buyurtmadan 12 oy oʻtgach, ularni ismingiz va aloqa maʼlumotlaringiz bilan birga oʻchiramiz (7-boʻlimga qarang).
text.C: **Xalqaro uzatish.** Hisob maʼlumotlaringiz va buyurtma maʼlumotlaringiz Buyuk Britaniyada saqlanadi va ishlov beriladi. Baʼzi ishlar undan tashqarida bajariladi: Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlaridagi Google xizmatidan foydalanadigan menyuni ajratib olish va WhatsApp avtomatik javoblari; Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlarida Meta bajaradigan WhatsApp xabarlarini yetkazish; Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlarida Stripe bajaradigan toʻlovlar; va Amerika Qoʻshma Shtatlarida Apple va Google yetkazadigan push-bildirishnomalar. Maʼlumotlar Buyuk Britaniyadan chiqqanda, uzatish Buyuk Britaniyaning adekvatlik qoidalari yoki Xalqaro maʼlumotlarni uzatish shartnomasi (International Data Transfer Agreement) yoki Qoʻshimcha (Addendum) bilan, mamlakatingiz qonunchiligi talab qilgan hollarda esa ushbu qonunchilik tan oladigan kafolat bilan ham qamrab olinadi. Qaysi kafolatlar qoʻllanilishi haqida bizdan batafsil maʼlumot soʻrashingiz mumkin.
text.G:
Bizning [Xizmat koʻrsatish shartlari](/terms) HatchGrab dan foydalaniladigan barcha mamlakatlarda amal qiladi. Baʼzi mamlakatlarda qoʻshimcha qoidalar bor. Bu sahifada ular har bir mamlakat boʻyicha alohida keltirilgan.

Quyidagi boʻlimlardan biri sizga taalluqli boʻlsa, u bizning Xizmat koʻrsatish shartlarimizning bir qismi hisoblanadi. Agar unda ulardan farqli narsa aytilgan boʻlsa, oʻsha mamlakat uchun ushbu sahifa amal qiladi.

Agar mamlakatingiz roʻyxatda boʻlmasa, qoʻshimcha qoidalar yoʻq: Xizmat koʻrsatish shartlari yozilganidek amal qiladi. Bizning [Maxfiylik siyosatimiz](/privacy) barcha mamlakatlarda bir xil.

back.A: **This policy applies regardless of where you are.** We follow the UK legislation on data protection, and in cases where the data protection legislation of the country you live in also applies, we follow that too.
back.B: **Notes about allergy and diet.** We pass them to the food truck together with your order and do not use them for anything else. 12 months after the order, we delete them together with your name and contact details (see section 7).
back.C: When data leaves Great Britain, the transfer is covered by the UK adequacy rules or by the International Data Transfer Agreement or the Addendum, and, in cases where the legislation of your country requires it, also by a safeguard that this legislation recognises.
back.D: Intro: Under the UK data protection legislation and, where it applies, the legislation of the country you live in, you have the following rights: / The legislation of the country you live in may give you these rights under other names, or give you additional rights too. You have those too. / **Sending a request.** Write to privacy@hatchgrab.com. Before acting, we will check that the request is genuine. You can entrust the request to someone else for you, and we will not treat you differently because you sent a request. We will reply within one month or, if the legislation of your country requires it, even sooner. If you ordered from a food truck, we may pass your request to that food truck, because it decides how your order data is used. If we reject a request, you can ask us to look at it again by writing a reply to our answer. / **Deleting your account.** [unchanged] When a food truck owner's account is deleted, we also remove its customers' names, contact details and notes from the orders we keep. / **Marketing emails.** We send marketing emails only where the legislation of the country you live in permits it, which in some countries means only with your consent. Each of them says who it is from, shows our postal address and says how to stop receiving them. If you ask us to stop, we will stop free of charge and within 10 working days. Emails about an order or your account are not marketing. If we or a food truck offer order updates by SMS, you will receive them only if you agree, and you can stop them at any time. / **If something goes wrong.** If a breach involving your personal data may cause you serious harm, in cases where the law requires it we will inform you and the data protection authority as quickly as possible, or help the food truck you ordered from to do so. / **Complaints.** First let us know by writing to privacy@hatchgrab.com; we would be grateful if you let us put the situation right ourselves. You can also complain to the data protection authority of the country you live in. In Great Britain this is the Information Commissioner's Office (Office of the Information Commissioner), website ico.org.uk or telephone number 0303 123 1113.
back.G: Our [Terms of Service](/terms) apply in all countries where HatchGrab is used. Some countries have additional rules. On this page they are set out separately for each country. / If one of the sections below applies to you, it is part of our Terms of Service. If it says something different from them, this page applies for that country. / If your country is not on the list, there are no additional rules: the Terms of Service apply as written. Our [Privacy Policy](/privacy) is the same in all countries.
